No personal/hobby details are publicly available — confirmed thin footprint there. I have enough to compile the brief now.

## Professional Accomplishments

- **Current role**: America's Market Lead, Retail and Consumer (Global Industries and Solutions), Google Cloud — since roughly January 2024. [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kapildabi/), [ZoomInfo](https://www.zoominfo.com/p/Kapil-Dabi/1502871126)
- **Career path**: Managing Director, Accenture, cloud/digital transformation practice (~2015–2017) → Partner/Principal, EY, Digital and Emerging Technology practice, Americas Digital Leader for Consumer Products & Retail (~2017–2021) → SVP, Digital Connected Commerce (Omnichannel) at Signet Jewelers (~2021–2024) → Google Cloud (2024–present). [RCAS 2019 speaker bio](https://events.ensembleiq.com/rcas-2019/speaker/57046/kapil-dabi), [TheOrg](https://theorg.com/org/signet-jewelers/org-chart/kapil-dabi)
- **Education**: MBA, Indian Institute of Management, Calcutta (IIM Calcutta). [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kapildabi/)
- 20+ years of consulting/retail advisory experience, per his 2019 EY bio.

## Notable Projects

- Publicly attributed retail AI case results he has cited in Google Cloud content: a home improvement retailer's AI visual search tool driving nearly $16M in incremental annual revenue on home décor; a consumer electronics retailer cutting contact resolution time by 30-90 seconds via AI assistants; 125,000+ store associates equipped with an AI assistant at a home improvement chain; a fast-food ordering agent with a 95% success rate. [Google Cloud Blog](https://cloud.google.com/transform/the-agentic-ai-revolution-reshaping-retail-and-consumer-interaction)
- Discussed Google's Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) at a Shoptalk fringe event with BigCommerce and other partners. [BigCommerce](https://www.bigcommerce.com/blog/building-for-the-agentic-era/)
- Featured Google Cloud Next 2025 session "Unlocking Retail Potential with Kapil Dabi." [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oFFBzD372wY)
- I could not directly verify his personal involvement in building AP2 or A2A (those appear to be Google-wide initiatives he discusses/represents publicly, not projects sourced to him by name in what I found).

## Personal/Background Details

Public footprint here is thin. Confirmed: based in the Dallas-Fort Worth area; MBA from IIM Calcutta. I found no verifiable hometown, family, or origin-story details, and searches for hobbies/personal interests returned nothing attributable to him (only unrelated people named Kapil).

## Interesting Non-Work Context (Icebreaker Material)

The one mildly distinctive fact: his career spans big-4/consulting (EY, Accenture) to operating a retailer's omnichannel function from the inside (Signet Jewelers) before moving to a hyperscaler — a "consultant who went client-side then vendor-side" arc, which could itself be a conversation opener about how the vantage point changed his view of AI adoption.

Personal/background and icebreaker material is genuinely thin: I found zero verifiable facts about hobbies, hometown, family, or origin story beyond his MBA institution and current Dallas-Fort Worth location. Do not fabricate personal color for this guest — recommend either researching him via a mutual connection/pre-call, or leaning on his career-arc pivot (consulting → client-side retail → Google) as the closest thing to a genuine, verified "human" detail.
